comments.author: chii
comments.why: State-space clustering shows why some games are hard to navigate.
comments.text: This reminds me of this nice video : [VIDEO] basically, the state space of the game can produce some intuition on why certain games are hard, and is demonstrated as a clustering of various states that are only linked to the winning state by a very small number of edges. So a player can easily "get lost" in the maze.
